verdict.rationale: Motion's own materials say its AI places tasks into calendar blocks within custom time windows so deadlines are met (motion-docs-10, motion-docs-57, motion-docs-17). They say it schedules against actual capacity (motion-docs-46), using a unified view of your calendars (motion-docs-55), and reshuffles the day and week automatically when meetings run long or emergencies arise (motion-docs-44). It also warns ahead of time when a task is at risk of missing its deadline (motion-docs-11). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that automatic re-planning works as claimed, and in-depth documentation beyond marketing copy of how scheduling handles meetings and deadline conflicts.
